pages.title: Lay a route
pages.text: Connect straight Flux Beams and Flux Bend Beams into a continuous route, with space for the vehicle and rider. These beams can be walked through.$(br2)Use a Flux Levitator item directly on a beam to place the cart, then right-click it without sneaking to board.

pages.title: Drive the cart
pages.text: Hold $(k:key.forward) to accelerate along the track in the direction you face. Facing the other way first slows the cart through zero, then reverses it. Hold $(k:key.back) to brake gradually to a stop. Release the keys to keep your speed.$(br2)Both end panels also set speed; the red control stops instantly. Sneak to dismount.$(br2)Carts can start from rest on bends. Slow down before testing a new route. No generator connection is needed.
